description: DeepSeek Harness desktop client (official direct download, NSIS installer 7z-unpack portable)
pre_install: if ($__app7z) { Expand-7zipArchive $__app7z.FullName "$dir"; Remove-Item "$dir\_extract" -Recurse -Force } else { Move-Item "$dir\_extract\*" "$dir" -Force; Remove-Item "$dir\_extract" -Recurse -Force }
notes: 跟踪官方 nightly 渠道（与 APP 内更新器一致）：feed https://download.deepseek.com/dsh-desk/feeds/win-x64/nightly.yml。
如想用稳定版，可改用静态 latest：https://download.deepseek.com/desktop/dsh-latest-windows-x64.exe（会落后于 nightly）。
